jobs.title: Accountant (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Accountant (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2027-01-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
You are passionate about numbers, work in a structured way, and are ready to take on responsibility in an exclusive environment? In our Finance Team, you ensure that two of the most renowned hotels in Switzerland are financially perfectly positioned. Your responsibilities – precise, diverse, impactful:
• You actively contribute to the preparation of monthly and annual financial statements and ensure transparent, reliable financial data.

• You are responsible for accounts payable — including payment transactions and timely payment runs.

• You ensure clean accounts receivable processes and handle dunning procedures professionally and solution-oriented.

• You manage lease agreements and handle invoicing for our residences using Opera Cloud.

• Start date: January 2027 or by arrangement.

## This is you
• You have a solid commercial education (or equivalent) and bring several years of experience in accounting.

• You communicate effortlessly in German and have good command of English.

• Excel is a tool you use efficiently — digital solutions excite you.

• You work independently, precisely, and enjoy taking ownership of your area of responsibility.

• Your professional demeanor, natural kindness, and polished appearance complete your profile.
  Become part of our Group Finance Team and actively shape the future of two iconic Swiss hotels — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. We look forward to receiving your application!

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

jobs.title: Digital Marketing Executive (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Digital Marketing Executive (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
Shape the digital future of two of the most renowned hotels in the Swiss Alps – the Kulm Hotel St. Moritz and the Grand Hotel Kronenhof Pontresina. As a Digital Marketing Executive, you will support our CRM & Digital Platforms Manager in maintaining, optimizing, and bringing the Kulm Group’s digital ecosystem to life for our guests at the highest level.Your Role & Responsibilities:
• Website & Platform Management: Maintain and update our websites      (front-end & CMS), manage content such as packages and events, support      SEO hygiene, and ensure a seamless user journey – from inspiration to the      booking engine.

• Online Listings & Reputation: Manage our presence on OTAs, partner      platforms, and directories, keep all information consistent, and      professionally oversee reputation management on portals such as TrustYou,      TripAdvisor, and Google.

• Digital Asset Management: Actively manage our Bynder system,      organize and tag visual assets, and coordinate photoshoots from      preparation to final asset handover.

• Reporting & Performance: Support the consolidation and      preparation of data for monthly performance reports.

• Team Coordination: Provide administrative support to the      Brand and Commercial team, prepare meetings, and ensure smooth      cross-departmental workflows.

## This is you
• Education: Successfully completed university degree (Bachelor) with a focus      on marketing, digital media, business administration, or a comparable      qualification.

• Experience: Initial practical experience in digital marketing, website      management, or online platform administration; basic knowledge of CMS      systems (and ideally HTML) is an advantage.

• Working Style: A structured, precise, and reliable      hands-on mentality with an exceptional eye for detail and brand      aesthetics.

• Competencies: Enthusiasm for digital user      experiences, strong organizational skills, and the ability to coordinate      multiple tasks in parallel and toward clear goals.

• Languages: Excellent written and spoken English skills; German C1. Italian is a strong asset.
What You Can Expect from Us:
• An Exclusive Environment: Work at the exciting intersection of      luxury hospitality and digital communication across two world-famous top      hotels.

• Room to Grow: A diverse range of responsibilities      with plenty of room for personal initiative and professional development      within the Kulm Group.

• Breathtaking Quality of Life: Live and work in the fascinating      Engadin mountain landscape and enjoy attractive employee benefits and      perks.
   Ready to take our digital presence to the next level? We look forward to receiving your complete application via our career portal.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

jobs.title: Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/w/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2026-11-01.

Where historic charm meets modern luxury – Grand Hotel Kronenhof in Pontresina is one of the most renowned 5-star superior hotels in Switzerland. Overlooking the fascinating Engadin mountain scenery, we celebrate hospitality at the highest level. To perfectly present this magical place for our guests, we are looking for a personality who has cleanliness, elegance and leadership in their blood.

## This is what you move with us
As Executive Housekeeper, you are the driving force behind the impeccable appearance of our hotel. You report directly to the Rooms Division Manager and lead an international team of approximately 24 employees.

• Quality assurance at 5-star level: You ensure impeccable cleanliness and living quality in all guest rooms and public areas – always in line with the demanding standards of Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes and Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). You are also responsible for our staff accommodation.

• Inspiring leadership: You are a coach and role model for your team. You are responsible for staff scheduling, conduct training sessions (equipment and cleaning procedures), carry out performance reviews and are actively involved in the recruitment process of new talents.

• Efficient management & logistics: You manage inventory, oversee the purchasing of hotel linen and uniforms, and coordinate the smooth laundry process in close cooperation with our sister hotel, Kulm.

• Interface professional: You are in daily contact with the Executive Management, Engineering, Floristry and Front Office to ensure smooth housekeeping operations.

## This is you
• Your foundation: Completed vocational training in the hotel industry (Hotel Management Specialist) or a professional qualification in Housekeeping Management, ideally complemented by specific further training.

• Your experience: Several years of management experience in Housekeeping, preferably in the 5-star hotel industry. The position is suitable for both experienced managers and committed junior managers who are ready to take the next step in their career.

• Your language skills: Must-have: Fluent German or English. Advantageous: Knowledge of Italian and/or Portuguese.

• Your personality: You are characterised by a keen eye for detail, strong business acumen, excellent organisational skills and absolute discretion.

• Start date: Flexible, by agreement.
What we offer:

• Affordable staff accommodation in Pontresina or Samedan.

• A workplace in one of the most beautiful locations in the Swiss Alps.

• Room for personal responsibility and extensive decision-making authority within your area.

• A motivated, interdisciplinary team and an excellent working environment in one of the top Swiss Deluxe Hotels.
Ready for the next step in your career? If you are ready for this challenge and would like to keep our Housekeeping team on the path to success, we look forward to receiving your comprehensive application.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Executive Housekeeping Manager (m/f/d) — Grand Hotel Kronenhof, Pontresina (Engadin, Grigioni). Carico di lavoro: 100%. Contratto: Unbefristet / Permanente. Inizio: 2026-10-01.

Dove il fascino storico incontra il lusso moderno – il Grand Hotel Kronenhof di Pontresina è uno dei più famosi hotel 5 stelle superior in Svizzera. Affacciato sull'affascinante paesaggio montano Engadin, celebriamo l'ospitalità al massimo livello. Per presentare perfettamente questo luogo magico per i nostri ospiti, stiamo cercando una personalità che ha pulizia, eleganza e leadership nel loro sangue.

## Questo è ciò che si muove con noi
Come Executive Housekeeper, sei la forza trainante dietro l'aspetto impeccabile del nostro hotel. Si segnala direttamente al Rooms Division Manager e guida un team internazionale di circa 24 dipendenti.

• Garanzia di qualità a 5 stelle: garantisce una pulizia impeccabile e una qualità di vita in tutte le camere e aree pubbliche – sempre in linea con gli standard esigenti di Swiss Deluxe Hotels, Forbes e Leading Quality Assurance (LQA). Siete anche responsabili per il nostro alloggio personale.

• Leader d'ispirazione: Sei un coach e un modello di ruolo per il tuo team. Siete responsabili della pianificazione del personale, delle sessioni di formazione di condurre (equipment e procedure di pulizia), delle recensioni sulle prestazioni e siete attivamente coinvolti nel processo di reclutamento di nuovi talenti.

• Gestione efficiente e logistica: gestisci l'inventario, sovrintende l'acquisto di biancheria d'albergo e uniformi, e coordina il processo di lavanderia liscio in stretta collaborazione con il nostro hotel sorella, Kulm.

• Interfaccia professionale: Lei è in contatto quotidiano con la Direzione Esecutivo, Ingegneria, Floristry e Front Office per garantire le operazioni di pulizia liscia.

## Sei tu.
• La vostra fondazione: Formazione professionale completa nel settore alberghiero (Hotel Management Specialist) o una qualifica professionale in Housekeeping Management, idealmente completato da specifica formazione ulteriore.

jobs.title: Hausdamenassistenz - Floor Supervisor Housekeeping (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Hausdamenassistenz - Floor Supervisor Housekeeping (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Saisonstelle / Seasonal. Start: 2026-12-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## This is what you move with us
• Daily Inspection & Quality Assurance: You will supervise and ensure the immaculate cleanliness of our luxurious guest rooms, residence apartments, and staff quarters. Your daily inspections guarantee that every space meets the highest standards of the Kulm Quality Standards, Swiss Deluxe Hotels, and Leading Hotels of the World.

• Professional Training: With your expertise and passion for perfection, you will train our staff, significantly contributing to the excellence of our housekeeping team. You will foster and develop the talents of our employees, ensuring a motivated and high-performing team.

• Support During Peak Times: You are flexible and ready to step in when needed. During peak periods and as a relief, you provide hands-on support on the floors and in the residences. Your versatility and willingness to help make you an indispensable member of our team.

• Plant Care: With a keen eye for detail, you oversee the care of our orchids and floor plants, preserving the elegant atmosphere of our property.

• Guest Relations: You utilize your outstanding communication skills to personally and individually attend to our hotel and residence guests, especially our long-standing regulars. You ensure that every guest feels completely at home and enjoys an unforgettable stay.

• Technical Responsibility: You ensure the proper handling of all machines, furnishings, equipment, and cleaning agents. Your technical understanding and diligence contribute to the smooth operation of our property.

• Material Care & Discretion: You strictly adhere to the regulations for cleaning various materials and ensure the highest level of discretion in all matters concerning our guests and the hotel.

• Maintenance Lists & Inventories: In collaboration with the housekeeping manager, you create maintenance lists and conduct inventories to ensure thorough documentation and stock control.

## This is you
• Experience in Luxury Hospitality: You have solid professional experience in a similar position and/or have worked as a room attendant in luxury hotels for several years. Your expertise in high-end hospitality makes you a true professional in your field.

• Language Skills: With your excellent command of German and English you can attend to our international guests at the highest level and impress them with your charm. Additional languages are an advantage.

• Commitment & Passion: Your attention to detail, ability to prioritize, and motivation to always deliver the best set you apart. You are a natural leader who takes responsibility and works with heart and mind.

## Benefits
At Kulm Group, our employees are the heart of our success. We offer attractive development opportunities, comfortable accommodations, affordable meals in the staff restaurant, and numerous perks.

jobs.title: Kitchen Director/ Chef de Cuisine - new All-Day Dining Outlet (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kitchen Director/ Chef de Cuisine - new All-Day Dining Outlet (m/w/d) — Kulm Hotel St. Moritz, St. Moritz (Engadin, Graubünden). Workload: 100%. Contract: Unbefristet / Permanent. Start: 2027-02-01.

People at 1800m above sea level are shaping the Luxury Mountain Travel. Our dynamic and international community offers our guests smart Luxury for an inimitable holiday experience. As a member of the Luxury Kulm Group you are part of the key to our success. Together, we make every stay deeply inspiring, unique and distinctive. And as such, we embrace our culture: understated luxury, inspiration, and a life experience. Together, we make it happen. This is your chance to be a member of our shaping culture:

## Something new is taking shape. And you will write the first chapter.
In the winter of 2027/28, Kulm Hotel St. Moritz will open a new all-day dining restaurant: French in style (offering refined yet relaxed dining), generous in spirit, and built with the clear ambition to become a new culinary benchmark in the Engadin from day one. We aren't revealing all the details just yet—but for the person chosen to shape this kitchen, we are happy to lift the curtain just a bit.  We are looking for a Kitchen Director who doesn't just accompany an opening, but leads it with vision, a strong hands-on mindset, and active leadership at the pass.What you will achieve with us:
• Strategic & Operational Setup: From the initial concept idea to the      grand opening night and beyond—you will drive the project from A to Z.

• A Distinct Culinary Signature: You will develop a culinary profile      that delights our discerning guests from their first morning coffee late      into the evening.

• Team Building & Leadership: Together with us, you will assemble a      high-performing brigade of around 20 chefs, leading them inspiringly and      fostering their growth.

• Internal Hub: Working in close alignment with hotel      management, Culinary Management, and the F&B team, you will actively      shape operational workflows, supplier networks, and purchasing.

• Uncompromising Standards & Control: Quality, flawless HACCP procedures,      food cost control, stock management, and sustainable waste reduction are      your daily benchmark.

## This is you:
• Proven Opening Expert: You have already managed a high-profile      restaurant opening or significantly contributed to one in a senior role      (e.g., as Executive Sous-Chef or Chef de Cuisine) – ideally within      bistro-style or upscale café-restaurant operations.

• High-End Background: You bring solid experience from luxury      hospitality and/or fine dining (comparable to a level of around 16      GaultMillau points).

• Passion for France: You are passionate about French      cuisine—and you know how to interpret it in a modern, light, contemporary      way, while remaining open to international influences.

• Leadership & Integrity ("Leader      at the Pass"):      You are actively involved in day-to-day kitchen operations. Clear      communication, leading by example, and mutual respect define your      management style. Teams naturally follow your lead.

• Language Skills: An international background is welcome.      Business-fluent English and/or Italian are required; good knowledge of      German is a strong advantage.
Why Kulm Hotel?
• Creative Autonomy: The rare opportunity to help shape a      new culinary concept right from the very beginning.

• Tradition Meets Future: Winter tourism once began at Kulm Hotel      St. Moritz—now write the next great chapter.

• Strong Environment: A highly professional, appreciative      team and full backing from the executive management.

## Benefits
At the Kulm Group, our employees are at the heart of our success. Alongside a forward-looking workplace in one of the world’s most beautiful destinations, we offer attractive career development opportunities, comfortable staff accommodation, excellent dining in our staff restaurant, and exclusive benefits.  Curious? We look forward to receiving your compelling application, including your CV and a brief note on what excites you most about this entrepreneurial role. Naturally, all inquiries will be treated with strict confidentiality.
